description: Recomputes MFM's long-term part of a price with the premium and the growth chosen by the user, with the same rule and bounds as the calculator of /en/top-down-bottom-up/#formula. Give exactly one of company (MFM company id: its owner earnings) or market (US, EU, JP, CH: the net income of the basket's companies, the published bottom-up route). erp and x are fractions (0.04 = 4%, 0.01 = 1 point); defaults 4% and 0; out-of-range values are refused. Owner earnings, the payable share q, the return on equity, growth g and the spreads are measured and fixed. The result moves toward the market price but never past it. Optional live comparison: live_price (company: price per share in the price currency; index or ETF: also month_end_price of the same instrument on MFM's price month). The long-term part is dated, not real time. Descriptive only, never advice.

company.description: MFM company id, as in /en/company/<id>/ (e.g. aapl)

erp.description: Equity risk premium chosen by the user, fraction (default 0.04; range in the parameter file)

live_price.description: Live price fetched by the AI itself (optional), same unit and currency as MFM's price

market.description: Index or state with a published bottom-up long-term part

month_end_price.description: Index or ETF only: close of the same instrument on MFM's price month end, from the same source as live_price

x.description: Growth above the 10-year government bond rate, fraction (default 0; range in the parameter file)

name: long_term_calculator
title: MFM long-term price calculator (formula v47)
